M-VERIFY.NAME: Verification digest loop
M-VERIFY.purpose: Agent-loop verification digest: scoped module runs, trust gate, failure artifact and JSON envelope (ADR-1, ADR-3, ADR-8).

fn-writeFailureReport.PURPOSE: Write the failure digest only on failure.

contract.purpose: Agent-loop verification digest: scoped module runs, trust gate, failure artifact and JSON envelope (ADR-1, ADR-3, ADR-8).

param.name: module
param.description: Optional module id; omitted means all modules.

param.name: results
param.description: Per-module outcome plus a compact digest.

notes.note-1: Failure details are written to .mygrace/last-failures.md only when something fails.
notes.note-2: Orchestration only: trust, planning and process execution stay in grace-test.ts.
notes.note-3: JSON mode exposes per-module ok, command, source, files and error.
